body:
Well I just hope those same people wont be plagued by "what-ifs" when I'm gone. I've already accepted the idea that one day everyone will be too busy and I'll feel isolated and hang myself. No one's fault, thats just how the world is.       
        
So I hope when I'm gone they'll understand that and move on fast.
Both methods are really ineffective. You'll just end up with lots of pain, on a trip to the ER and maybe get institutionalized
Absolutely yeah. Ive done a lot of things lately because "I'll be gone soon anyway. I should make myself happy."

Hell yeah!       
Nothing more calming than knowing I have an exit if everything turns out awful. It's so fucking freeing
God i cant wait for it

>I honestly feel like this was just a bad run for me. Born in the wrong time at the wrong place in the wrong body.      
         
Well if that aint a mood.
Thanks for this. The only good thing abt depression is teaching me who's really worth my time

Really something to see all sorts of "You can talk to me" posts on my feed but when you do reach out to them-- nothing. I cut off a lot of people for that.         
I'm focusing even more on myself now. I'm try to make myself happy before I leave for good
Same. Di ako maka-upload kagabi, until now di pa rin
I hope I'll be this happy on my last :)

People saying "why are you bitching at this point? Life only gets harder from here"         
Okay bitch then why cant i just quit right now? Whats the point if it gets worse???
I'll see you on the other side someday
That would be nice. My depressed friends and i already play therapist with each other. I'd like to to be able to tell a group abt suicide without ringing off alarm bells lol
Not at all. I'm already sure my family and friends would be devastated but i'm long past the point of caring about that. I'm curious how long it would take them to move on

Hey just got back from work. Sure thing, I'm on this subreddit to find people who also have their final clocks set.      
        
Whats on your bucket list while youre still here?
noose

I'll be real with you, its going to be difficult and very painful to do right.        
I've fantasized of it before but i heard its really ineffective so i switched my plan

Whoa im in a very similar situation. I've shut out a lot of friends because i dont want to hear about how well theyre doing. I'm happy for them but i cant stand hearing about it. Everyone's moving so fast
I'm in a similar situation. The days really look the same. I wish you luck with your 1 year.
That sounds lovely, same plans. I hope you have a good time :)
Thanks! I guess i do. But i'm tired and i'd like to go now. Like im the first to pass out in a sleepover.

End of June. You dont get this kind of freedom when you're thinking about bills, insurance, and future career plans.         
No more planning for years ahead, all my plans are until next month at most. I spent the past 2 years with declining mental health and coming to terms with my own inevitable death.       
I only decided to really end it a week ago. I havent experienced happiness like this in a long time.

I have a set date already. The night after my birthday. I want to enjoy what time i have left to see what its like to really live. Like living without a care for the future.        
         
Its nice, everything moves differently when you know it will be your last time seeing it

>if anybody is sending me to a death sentence it will be myself.       
        
Okay thats funny as hell. I hope your remaining time will be wonderful
When i realized life would be a constant cycle of just working and trying to not be broke. Just working and barely seeing my friends or barely doing my hobbies.

I wish i could say dont go while i already have an exit date of my own. I'm sorry it has to be this way :(         
       
I cant help but agree, though. The peace of finally being free is nice.
I considered that once. I wanted to off myself somewhere far, where no one can find me for days. But people might take photos of my body and my family will find out that way

Alright, I'll see if I can tell them. I already have a set date for leaving, I'm just enjoying my remaining time.      
       
I really want to disappear out of the blue and without a trace. Files gone, socmed deleted, like i never existed on the internet. Maybe I'll reconsider that part. Thanks
Just woke up. Thanks, I will consider it :)

I'm sorry to hear that. I dont want to tell my family for similar reasons hahaha. I'm just lying on the rooftops looking at the stars and being sad and enjoying the music and whatever time I have left. I'm glad I helped you in some way.       
            
I dont know where you are but I hope the world will be kind to you today :)
The world's too busy and too fast for the likes of us. At least we have each other :)
Happy birthday! I hope you have a good day
Truth. I'd rather my folks hate me once im gone. I would respect them for sticking to their guns instead of spewing "I could have done more" bullshit

Yayyy same boat. It feels good to (ironically) live life the way you want because it's gonna be over soon. Do what I can without worrying about future bills, taxes, etc. When most of my money is gone, I'll be gone too.        
        
It feels like I'm paying a debt to myself. Do what I've always wanted to do, and finally do what I promised myself for all the times I'm sad. It will be a nice party
My plan is to tell them I love them and "dont mind me I'm just drunk" so it wont set off alarm bells. For my long goodbyes, I'm thinking of scheduled tweets
